changes.label: Statue Square → Victoria Peak

values.title: Statue Square → Victoria Peak
values.description: Road ascent; green minibus 1 by default, Bus 15 or taxi if the queue/traffic makes it better.
values.transport_instructions: From Statue Square walk 10–15 min to Hong Kong Station Public Transport Interchange / minibus terminus beneath IFC; board green minibus 1 to The Peak. Allow waiting and a final viewpoint walk. If the 19:30 projection backup is used, depart about 20:00 and shift later blocks together.

transportOptions.name: Green minibus 1
transportOptions.route: Statue Square → walk 10–15 min to Hong Kong Station PTI beneath IFC → green minibus 1 → The Peak terminus → viewpoint walk.
transportOptions.notes: About 45–60 min door to door; limited seats can cause queues. Fare published by TD; recheck before travel.

transportOptions.name: Bus 15
transportOptions.route: Walk about 5–10 min to City Hall, Connaught Road Central, Peak-bound stop → Citybus 15 → The Peak terminus.
transportOptions.notes: About 55–75 min door to door, including wait, traffic and viewpoint walk. Confirm Peak-bound stop/direction in Citybus app.

transportOptions.name: Taxi
transportOptions.route: Ask staff for an accessible legal taxi pickup / Mandarin Oriental or nearby hotel rank after walking out of controlled roads → The Peak Galleria.
transportOptions.notes: About 30–45 min including pickup and final walk; actual meter/traffic applies. No assumed pickup inside closed Chater Road.

details.farePerPerson: Green minibus 1 HK$11.80; Bus 15 HK$13. Taxi is per car.
details.fareForTwo: Recommended minibus: HK$23.60. Alternatives replace it; do not add their costs.
details.crowdNote: Use taxi if the minibus queue is excessive and road traffic is reasonable. Bus 15 needs a longer allowance; reduce the Peak stay or move ferry later. Do not return to the Peak Tram queue by default.
details.fallback: If substituting Lee Tung or Causeway Bay for the night Peak, skip this ascent, the Peak visit and descent together. Central → Wan Chai MTR (towards Chai Wan), Exit D for Lee Tung: 20–30 min door to door, HK$5.90/adult / HK$11.80/two. Central → Causeway Bay MTR, Exit F2 for Lee Gardens: 25–35 min, HK$5.90/adult / HK$11.80/two. Attend only confirmed event/date/time, then MTR back towards Kennedy Town to Central and walk to Pier 7 if the late Star Ferry fits; otherwise Admiralty → Yau Ma Tei. These replace the same evening slot and cost allowance.

changes.label: Roast goose, char siu & crispy pork

values.body:
29 Dec, 19:00–20:30: Chung Wah Roast Goose / 中華燒鵝傳承, G/F 497A Nathan Road, near Yau Ma Tei Exit C. A relaxed dinner after Lantau. Roast goose is the priority: start with rice meals for two, share, and add char siu or crispy pork only if good value. The three tastings may happen at different meals. Allow HK$160–200 total for two as a planning estimate, not a menu quotation. A third-party guide reports an approximately HK$80 solo goose-and-crispy-pork set; its current contents and price remain unverified. Published regular hours are 10:00–22:00 daily; that does not guarantee goose stock at 19:00. Check current prices, evening stock / fresh-batch timing and whether reservation or preorder is useful before travel.

Walk: from Exit C allow 3–5 minutes, HK$0. From Bridal Tea House, 6 Arthur Street, the mapped walk via Arthur Street and Man Ming Lane is about 170 m / 2 minutes; allow 3–5 minutes, HK$0, and the same for the return. If goose is unavailable, Ki’son at 546 Nathan Road, Shops B–C, G/F, Mong Kok Building, near Exit A2 is about 230 m / 4 minutes from Chung Wah; allow 5–8 minutes with crossings, HK$0. Use it only if open and stocked.

1 Jan evening now uses Causeway Bay cheap snacks and Elf Village projections, followed by a direct hotel return. The former Mong Kok/Ki’son crawl is retired. Try remaining roast meats at the 29 Dec dinner or another convenient meal; keep tastings independent and portions small. Ki’son is optional elsewhere, not an extra 1 Jan detour.

Order 半肥瘦叉燒: half-fat, half-lean char siu, sweet barbecued pork. 燒肉 / 燒腩仔 is crispy roast pork belly. Tick goose, char siu and crispy pork independently after tasting. Keep no beef / no beef broth, including any complimentary or optional soup; confirm ingredients or skip soup.

Foodpanda Mong Kok online base prices checked 1 Nov 2026, before promotions: goose rice from HK$70; two-meat rice from HK$70; goose plus one other meat rice from HK$75. Supplements may apply. These are not verified dine-in prices or prices for the Yau Ma Tei branch. Mong Kok’s published regular 10:00–22:00 daily hours do not confirm New Year’s Day opening or meat stock. Ki’son remains an optional fallback outside the new 1 Jan evening route.

25 Dec stays flexible: nearby roast meats are only an optional early opportunity after Aqua Luna if open and stocked; late-evening goose is not the main plan. No extra compulsory visit. Dinner / tasting allowances replace or form part of existing meal spending; do not count another dinner.

changes.label: Arrival at Hong Kong Airport

values.body:
After the 13:30 landing, clear immigration and collect bags; allow 60–90 min and treat all later times as targets. Use airport Wi-Fi and save the order QR/vouchers offline.
SmarTone: U Roaming, Terminal 1 Arrivals counter A16; saved booking hours 07:00–23:30 daily. Show the Trip.com order-detail QR and passport, complete real-name registration and test data.
Tourist Octopus: collect the TWO prepaid cards at Arrivals Hall A, A01 Eternal East; voucher hours 08:00–21:00. Each includes HK$50. Check T-Union logo and balance.
Then spend at most 5 min asking whether a 1O1O still operates on T1 L5 and redeems this exact Agoda/KKday CSL voucher. Older references name it; the current official shop lists and designated redemption list omit the airport. Do not rely on airport redemption or search other floors.
Target A21 15:15 → hotel 16:30; rest until 17:10. If CSL is still uncollected, bus/MTR to 1O1O, 28 Hankow Road, for about 17:40–18:05, then walk to the Christmas waterfront. Skip the store if airport redemption succeeded. Withdraw only a small amount of HKD if needed.
After the SIM pickup, walk to the Cultural Centre Viewing Deck by 19:00 for free TST WinterFest, then museums until about 20:20; dinner around 20:30. If pickup is late, dinner first and projections afterward until 01:00 on 26 Dec. The unbooked cruise is retired; there is no pier check-in. Recheck pickup hours, voucher validity and projection access before travel.

changes.label: WinterFest — three evenings and rechecks

values.title: WinterFest — three evenings and rechecks
values.summary: 25 Dec TST · 26 Dec Central + night Peak · 1 Jan Causeway Bay · TST projections suspended on NYE
values.body:
25 Dec: walk from Hankow Road via Christmas waterfront to the Cultural Centre Viewing Deck by 19:00. The Stars of Christmas Concert at Clock Tower/Cultural Centre, then Northern Lights at Museum of Art/Space Museum; free outdoor viewing and walking. Our 19:00–20:20 block is a visit target, not confirmed individual show times. Published 25 Dec window 19:00–01:00 on 26 Dec. Dinner about 20:30; if SIM pickup is late, dinner first and projections afterward. Both TST displays suspended 31 Dec; partial suspension 28–30 Dec.
26 Dec: Statue Square Gardens 17:45–19:30; 22-metre tree/Christmas Express/market if operating. Tree lights 18:00, South Statue Square projection 19:00, repeats every 30 min; 19:30 backup shifts onward plan about 30 min. Current Christmas Town window on Boxing Day is 11:00–01:30 on 27 Dec; projection window 19:00–01:00 on 27 Dec. Separate market Sat/public-holiday 12:00–22:00 is from the brief and needs reconfirmation. Night Peak is default via green minibus 1 / Bus 15 / taxi, then Central→TST Star Ferry if timing permits. Lee Tung snowfall only replaces Peak if an official 20:00-or-later 26 Dec show is confirmed. Causeway Bay market/parade can replace the same slot if confirmed for 26 Dec but absent on 1 Jan.
1 Jan: Monster Building in daylight, westbound MTR to Causeway Bay, shared cheap snacks about 18:00, Elf Village on Lan Fong/Pak Sha Road 19:00–19:45 within the published 19:00–22:00 window, optional Mammy Pancake about 19:50 (regular closes 20:45, holiday hours unconfirmed). Market/parade/workshops need confirmed dates/times. Return via Admiralty directly to Yau Ma Tei for packing.
NYE: HKTB has announced Victoria Harbour fireworks; detailed viewing/access, crowd-control and transport announcements pending. Symphony of Lights ends 18 Nov 2026 and is not a Christmas/NYE attraction.

Adult Octopus fare reference HK$22.20 each way: HK$44.40 for two per leg, HK$88.80 round trip. Allow station walks, two transfers, gate/security time and the post-show exit crowd.
While in World of Frozen for rides, visit the winter market/festive stalls; Olaf appearance is possible without an assigned time. Prioritise Santa Goofy’s Main Street tree lighting with snowfall/drone effects alongside castle Momentous. Fit the daytime Mickey/Minnie Christmas castle stage show around rides. January 5 Arendelle Winterfest is also after the trip.
